dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'C' and 'O' shaped light-toned structures distributed across the dorsal-lateral surface, featuring sharp high-contrast perimeters that transition into lower-intensity internal regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the cranial-dorsal region and interspersed between larger ring structures.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest and most prominent macro-annuli located mid-body form an obtuse triangular spatial relationship.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast white edging along the terminal margins of the posterior flippers.
